description: This file defines the class S3UriParser, which provides methods to parse S3 URIs or URLs into their components such as bucket, key, region, and style. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP and handles various S3 URI formats including stream wrapper URIs, custom endpoints, and virtual-hosted style URLs.

classes.name: S3UriParser
classes.description: A class for parsing Amazon S3 URIs or URLs into components such as bucket, key, region, and style.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a given URI or URL into its S3 components including bucket, key, region, and style.

methods.name: parseS3UrlComponents
methods.description: Extracts scheme, host, and path components from a custom S3 URL string.

methods.name: parseStreamWrapper
methods.description: Parses a stream wrapper URI into bucket and key components.

methods.name: parseCustomEndpoint
methods.description: Parses custom endpoint URIs into bucket and key components.

methods.name: parsePathStyle
methods.description: Parses path-style S3 URLs into bucket and key components.

methods.name: parseVirtualHosted
methods.description: Parses virtual-hosted style S3 URLs into bucket and key components.
